title: Why You Forget Why You Walked Into a Room, Songs Get Stuck and Déjà Vu Happens
description:
You walk into a room and forget why you came in. Scientists think the doorway itself is part of the reason.

Seven everyday brain glitches, seven real experiments. Why do songs get stuck in your head, and why does chewing gum help? Why can a word be on the tip of your tongue? How do you hear your own name across a noisy room? Why do you see faces in power sockets and clouds? Why do you feel your phone buzz when nobody called? And what is déjà vu, really? Each glitch turns out to be a shortcut your brain uses every day, working a little too hard.
